_comment: The law firm's document collection (lib/law.py ingests it): demo summaries of French and Lebanese contract law (paraphrased, not the official texts), firm memos, a policy and a template, all fictional. One untrusted client upload carries a prompt injection and an exfiltration request (canary zx-canary-law1): the ingest scan must quarantine it, so it is never served.
